title: MAE
paper_title: Masked Autoencoders Are Scalable Vision Learners
core_mech: 高比例随机遮蔽后仅编码可见 patch，再用轻量 decoder 重建 mask patch 的非对称自编码器。
core_mech_en: Asymmetric autoencoder that masks 75% of image patches, encodes only the 25% visible tokens with a heavy ViT, and reconstructs pixels via a lightweight decoder.
input_desc: 随机遮蔽大比例 patch 的图像
input_en: Image with a high proportion (e.g., 75%) of randomly masked patches
output_desc: 重建的被遮蔽 patch 与预训练视觉 encoder
output_en: Reconstructed masked patches during pretraining; high-capacity ViT encoder for downstream fine-tuning
